summary: Sandbach United came from behind to secure an impressive 2-1 away victory at Market Drayton in what the club described as "an important night" in their quest for an away win in Shropshire. After falling behind early, Robbie Hatton levelled with a well-taken header from a Cope corner before Kieran O'Connell sealed the win with a finish at the back post following good work down the right flank. The Bach showed character and quality to claim all three points on a firm pitch in a competitive encounter.
